facebook.music_reuse_policy: Confirm Facebook clearance before reusing Instagram music.
facebook.schedule_notes: Publish as a six-photo album or carousel; optionally attach the short slideshow separately.

threads.schedule_notes: Lead with the text; attach two contrasting carousel frames or the clean slideshow.
